Today, there is an update on the November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast.

## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
A low-pressure system is currently brewing over the Bay of Bengal and is expected to intensify into a depression by tomorrow, October thirty-first. This system is approaching the South Andhra Coast and is anticipated to bring significant rainfall. North Tamil Nadu, including the Chennai–Puducherry coast, is likely to experience rain, while Coastal Andhra Pradesh may receive heavy rain starting from November first. Authorities are monitoring the situation closely, with discussions already underway regarding potential school holidays in Tamil Nadu for October thirty-first due to the expected cyclone and rain.
